name: Pack 5: the analog synth
words: The analog synth’s patches (basses, pads, strings, brass, leads, plucks, bells) on pack 4’s grooves and drums; in the DAW they play live on the synth, here the browser’s nearest sound stands in.

sounds.name: Round bass
sounds.words: The analog synth: a saw and a pulse an octave down through the ladder, its envelope plucking it open. The bass of a hundred records.

sounds.name: Acid line
sounds.words: The analog synth: one saw, the ladder near screaming, a short envelope; accents open it, held notes slide into the next.

sounds.name: Warm pad
sounds.words: The analog synth: a pulse whose width the LFO sweeps, beside a detuned saw, through a lazy ladder; the bucket-brigade chorus and a little echo.

sounds.name: Brass stabs
sounds.words: The analog synth: two saws a little apart through the state-variable filter, its envelope swelling a beat late, the way brass speaks.

sounds.name: Sync lead
sounds.words: The analog synth: oscillator 2 hard-synced to 1, the filter envelope sweeping its pitch: the tearing lead. Vibrato comes in after the note starts.

sounds.name: String machine
sounds.words: The analog synth: two saws, a slow swell, the high-pass taking the weight off, and the fast chorus that makes one voice an ensemble.

sounds.name: Reese bass
sounds.words: The analog synth: six voices stacked on one note and detuned, spread wide, the filter breathing slowly: a bass that moves inside itself.

sounds.name: Plucked arpeggio
sounds.words: The analog synth: a narrow pulse with a saw an octave up, plucked shut by a fast envelope, the echo answering on the dotted eighth.

sounds.name: Hoover
sounds.words: The analog synth: eight voices in unison, pulses whose widths swim, a saw an octave down, sliding between notes: the rave classic.

sounds.name: Wobble
sounds.words: The analog synth: the cutoff swung by the LFO in eighths, the bass and sub under a saw, driven: the filter does the rhythm.

sounds.name: Ring bell
sounds.words: The analog synth: a triangle ring-modulated by a sine at an odd ratio: partials no harmonic series has, ringing away like struck metal.

sounds.name: Dub chord
sounds.words: The analog synth: a minor-seventh stab plucked shut, the low end cut, thrown into a long dark echo: minimal techno's chord.

sounds.name: Noise drone
sounds.words: The analog synth: two low saws and noise through a resonant band-pass that a slow random LFO wanders, held, into a long feedback echo.

sounds.name: Vintage lead
sounds.words: The analog synth: two saws and the sub through the ladder, gliding between held notes; push the mod wheel for vibrato.

sounds.name: Round bass · Mix Lab
sounds.words: The analog synth: a saw and a pulse an octave down through the ladder, plucked open. As the Mix Lab's analog set plays it.

sounds.name: Warm pad · Mix Lab
sounds.words: The analog synth: a pulse the LFO sweeps beside a detuned saw, a lazy ladder, the bucket-brigade chorus. As the Mix Lab's analog set plays it.

sounds.name: Plucked pulse · Mix Lab
sounds.words: The analog synth: a narrow pulse and a saw an octave up, plucked shut by a fast envelope. As the Mix Lab's analog set plays it.

sounds.name: Soft mallet · Mix Lab
sounds.words: The analog synth: a triangle and a sine an octave up, struck and ringing away, like a marimba. As the Mix Lab's analog set plays it.

harmonies.name: F minor add 9
harmonies.words: One chord, low and heavy (you chose it twice).

harmonies.name: A minor 7
harmonies.words: One plain chord: the movement all in the rhythm.

harmonies.name: A pedal, the top moving
harmonies.words: A minor 7, sus4, minor 9 over the same A.

harmonies.name: D minor 7 ↔ 9
harmonies.words: One root, the ninth coming and going.

harmonies.name: A semitone up and back
harmonies.words: E minor 7, then F major 7, 8 bars each.

harmonies.name: Sus2 drift
harmonies.words: C sus2 and D sus2, 4 bars each.
